title: Pomodoro Sauce

items: ¼ cup Extra virgin olive oil

steps: Wash the tomatoes and optionally slice in half before placing them in a large pot over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the tomatoes to a food mill after they soften to remove the pulp.
Add the passata (tomato puree) back to the pot along with the rest of the ingredients and simmer until reduced to a tomato sauce consistency, approximately 15 minutes.
